crossRefs.note: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by…
“Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have…
Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”
Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him…

people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of Yahweh’s house. Samuel was afraid to show Eli the vision.
translations.bsb: Samuel lay down until the morning; then he opened the doors of the house of the LORD. He was afraid to tell Eli the vision,
translations.kjv: And Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the house of the LORD. And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision.
translations.asv: And Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the house of Jehovah. And Samuel feared to show Eli the vision.
